title: No timed proof exists that a first-time user reaches a populated multi-panel cockpit via conversation alone in under 2 minutes
repro: design: SC-001 is a timed acceptance bar; no session report or test records a stopwatch run of a first-time, freshly-configured user driving 'research a company' to a populated cockpit.
evidence: Agent-OS spine + §6.5 gate proven live: REBUILD_R4_REPORT.md 'Agent-OS spine works end-to-end' (add-to-watchlist tool-call -> host action -> gate -> applied); src/lib/host-actions.ts (open_panel/arrange_layout cases, :603-689); src/lib/layout-templates.ts:196-218 dispatches a full research-cockpit template from a query with zero manual panel clicks.
notes: The capability (agent opens a populated multi-panel cockpit via conversation with no manual panel controls) is architecturally present, but no session report or test measures an actual first-time-user run against the <2min wall-clock target; SC-001 is a timed acceptance bar and no timing evidence exists.

title: Screener cold/warm timing misses both SC-034 numeric targets (only the skip-rate target is met)
repro: Full S&P 500 screen, live: warm run measured 2.84s (target: sub-second) and cold run measured 329.8s / a throttled 32.7s-for-50-symbols scaled up (target: single-digit seconds) — REBUILD_R4_SESSION2_REPORT.md 's own perf table, filed under the flagged/BUILT bucket, not VERIFIED.
evidence: REBUILD_R4_SESSION2_REPORT.md screener perf table: S&P 500 warm 2.84s / 0 skips (itemized), cold 329.8s (batch 429-throttled -> per-symbol fallback, 0 skips); the <5% skip target is met (0%). | docs/redesign/REBUILD_R4_SESSION2_REPORT.md 'Screener perf numbers' table
notes: Both numeric timing targets are missed as measured: warm 2.84s is not 'sub-second', and cold 329.8s (or even the un-throttled batch path) is far above 'single-digit seconds'. The session's own report labels this row not VERIFIED but the flagged/BUILT bucket, attributing cold time to an IP-level Yahoo rate limit reproduced even via system curl — a real, load-bearing quality-bar miss for 0.9.0, not a rounding gap.

repro: design: to add a data source today you must add a sidecar ProviderDeclaration row (sidecar/services/provider_registry.py:80), a hand-written row + static import in src/lib/marketplace.ts:20-45,84-335, and a plugin data-capability declaration (e.g. plugins/yfinance/index.ts:1-12) — three host-code touch points, not the contract-driven zero-host-code path SC-007 promises.
evidence: Generic credential form: src/modules/marketplace/MarketplacePanel.tsx:244-274 renders entry.credentialFields; provenance: sidecar/services/provider_registry.py:16-18 (provider field on every result). BUT catalog is a host-compiled static list: src/lib/marketplace.ts:20-45 (static imports), :84-335 (hand-written rows); sidecar registry is an in-module declaration table: sidecar/services/provider_registry.py:80
notes: 0 lines of per-source UI holds, but a new data source still needs host code in three places (sidecar provider + ProviderDeclaration row, marketplace.ts row + static import). The TS plugin data capability is a thin declaration (plugins/yfinance/index.ts:1-12), not what the registry resolves.
